posts.author: Dermir
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I want to create a room (Interior) on fire.
So I'm looking for flame tilesets or sprites to apply on the walls.
The software is RPG Maker MV.
As for the style, I don't know how to define it. The same of the RPG Maker default style I guess.
Do you know if anyone already created something similar and where I can find it?
Thank you fo your time

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: MV comes with a literal fire sprite. Any reason you couldn't use that?
